title: [finding] `check:skill-examples` spells a PREREQUISITE refusal as `exit 1`, so `--ran` reconciliation reads it as a RED
body:
Path: P? | 门禁分类 | `check:skill-examples` 把「前提未满足」拼成 `exit 1` —— 与真发现同码,`--ran` 对账会读成 RED

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution PM seat 3 (#18883, session `session_01HnRAeVTLJevtQ5iCPX6JSm`) out of the **#19320 / PR #19442** round, from that dev's own out-of-scope finding. ⛔ Filed bare: `finding` only — `domain:*`, type and priority are triage's.

Dedupe words: `skill-examples exit 1 prerequisite refusal` · `EXIT_PREREQUISITE_NOT_MET adoption spec gates` · `client-react dist unbuilt gate refusal code`.

## The mechanism

`scripts/check-skill-examples.ts` **refuses** when `packages/client-react/dist` holds no declarations — and it spells that refusal **`exit 1`**, the same code a real finding uses. Its sibling gates use the dedicated **`exit 3`** for exactly this state.

⭐ The gate's own text is unambiguous — 「A verdict now would be computed against a build that no longer matches src」 — so a **human** reading the log is not misled. **A runner that classifies by exit code alone is**, and that is precisely what `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciliation does.

## Why it matters

⛔ This is the **false-red** direction of the very class `exit 3` exists to prevent. The repo already treats the distinction as load-bearing:

- `exit 3` = PREREQUISITE NOT MET — ⛔ not a red, ⛔ not a green
- `exit 1` = a finding

A seat that trusts the reconciliation reads an unbuilt `client-react` as a **failing gate on its diff**, and either chases a defect that is not there or — worse — learns to discount reds from this gate.

## Measured on the #19320 round

The dev hit it, refused to bank it as NOT MEASURED, **built the closure and re-ran to a real verdict**: `exit 0`, **258** prose examples type-checked across 3 surfaces, including the **10 spec-source TSDoc blocks** — the surface that diff edits. So the gate's verdict was green once its prerequisite was met; only its refusal code was wrong.

## ⛔ What is NOT established

- **No repro beyond that single run.** The condition needs an unbuilt `packages/client-react/dist`, which is the ordinary state of a fresh checkout on this box but was not varied deliberately.
- Whether any **other** gate in the same family shares the spelling — ⛔ not censused.
- Whether `--ran` has a second signal (log text, a marker) that would let it classify correctly without changing the exit code.

The repair looks like a one-line classification change in that gate, but it is somebody else's instrument and this card asks for the reading, ⛔ not the patch.
